##: Every push to main runs the release workflow, which rewrites `version` and
both `architecture.*.hash` values with jq — structure is edited by hand,
digests are not. Zeroed hashes are the bootstrap placeholders the first
release after this file landed replaces.
`$version` in a url is substituted by Scoop itself, so the urls never
blocks against the release build matrix.
description: Local-first outliner with CRDT sync: TUI, CLI and MCP server (beta channel, rebuilt on every push to main)
notes: outl is on your PATH as `outl`. `outl --help` lists the commands; `outl init <dir>` scaffolds a workspace and `outl` with no arguments opens the TUI on today's journal.
This is the beta channel: it tracks every push to main. Pin a version with `scoop hold outl-beta` if you would rather upgrade on purpose.
